office: Apostle of the Seventy, Bishop of Sardis

names.form: Άγιοι Απελλής, Λουκάς και Κλήμης οι Απόστολοι

names.note: His own name, read out of «Св. Аполос, Лукије и Климент» in this folder’s Serbian citation.

death.note: As printed by days.pravoslavie.ru for 10 сентября ст. ст.: “Апп. от 70-ти Апеллия, Лукия и Климента (I)” — the century is given for the three together. Bounded at 30 rather than at the century's own first year, the way Cornelius the centurion and the martyrs of Skepsis already are: one of the Seventy followed Christ, so he cannot have died before the ministry.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 сентября ст. ст. — «Апп. от 70-ти Апеллия, Лукия и Климента (I)»

attestations.note: A SECOND RUSSIAN DAY, AND THE ROW WAS NOT MOVED. The 22 апреля ст. ст. day page prints «Апп. Нафанаила , Луки и Климента (I).» and the third name link behind that line is page 1254, «Климент, апостол от 70-ти, сщмч.», whose life, life1502, is the same two-sentence notice this folder already stands on: «Святой апостол Климент был епископом в Сардике (в древности богатый город Лидии в Малой Азии)», with the mention in Philippians 4:3. That page heads «Дни памяти: 4 января (70 ап.) , 22 апреля , 10 сентября», so 22 апреля is a second Russian day for this folder. One attestation row per church is the schema: the row stands on 10 сентября, where the day page that was read for it printed him, he does not render on 22 апреля, and 4 января is recorded and NOT READ. The companions differ between the two days — Апеллий and Лукий on 10 сентября, Нафанаил and the Evangelist Лука on 22 апреля — and the Luke of the April line is `luke-the-evangelist`, a different man from the `luke-apostle-of-laodicea` of the September one. Nothing else was added: the 22 апреля reading gives this folder no word its own life does not already have. Not checked: azbyka.ru, and the 4 января day page.
Not on doxologia.ro’s list for 10 septembrie (checked 2026-08-23); no other day checked.

Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 22 апреля ст. ст. — «Апп. Нафанаила, Луки и Климента (I).»

attestations.note: A SECOND russian row, out of the withheld-second-day backlog. The folder’s first russian row stands on 10 сентября ст. ст. and was NOT moved, altered or re-sourced. Its own note already recorded this day and refused it in the words “one row per church is the schema” — the prohibition the author lifted on 2026-10-03, after which `attestationsIn` in src/lib/church.js has been plural by design and schema/saint.schema.json sets no uniqueness on `attestations`. **That sentence in the first row’s note is now wrong and this row supersedes it**; the note itself was left as it stands rather than rewritten, because copying a venerated row back to edit its prose is not what `replace_venerated` is sanctioned for. Three things were checked before this row was written, and the day rests on all three: the calendar’s own list of HIS days heads his name page — «Дни памяти: 4 января (70 ап.) , 22 апреля , 10 сентября» — and this day is in it; the day page for it prints a line for him, «Апп. Нафанаила, Луки и Климента (I).», which is what the `source` quotes; and the name link behind that line is https://days.pravoslavie.ru/name/1254.html, the same name page the folder’s existing row was read from. His place in the line is «Климента», the third of three names, and the link behind it is name page 1254, «Климент, апостол от 70-ти, сщмч.», whose life is the same two-sentence notice this folder already stands on. The companions differ between his two days, which is why neither line is a repetition of the other. 4 января stays a note and no row: «(70 ап.)» is the synaxis of the Seventy, a company whose heading enumerates nobody.
